answers.core: This type of progress bar can be very useful, especially when creating retro-like games. Beginners and new users may aim for a game like this to learn to use the engine and not finding a node that does this for them may not be the most appealing.
answers.workaround: The best workaround I can think of is creating a custom Control node with this behaviour. A NinePathRect which is only drawn a percentage of it.
